text: Vile Satyr! Dryads in Danger!

Listen, I don't know who you are, but I need your help. My sisters went to take back the Branch of Cenarius from the satyr. They said they'd be back soon, but it's been two whole days!

<name>, you have to find them! They were looking for the ruins of a night elf temple in Xavian to the northeast. I don't know what to think. Look for Anilia, she was leading them on the search.
Find Anilia in Xavian.
Judging by the gaping wound in her side, Anilia is on the verge of death.
The Branch of Cenarius

Anilia puts her hands on your shoulders and draws you close. Gasping, she points towards the arch to the north, before her eyes close and her last wheezing breath leaves her body. "He has taken it... Geltharis..." You know in your heart that Anilia's dying wish is to see the Branch of Cenarius back in dryad hands.
Kill Geltharis and return the Branch of Cenarius to Illiyana at the Shrine of Aessina.
Have you found them? What did Anilia say? Where is she?

Anilia died? No... that can't be! It was just yesterday that we were running and playing together in the woods.

I guess those days are over...
Satyr Slaying!

I can't believe that Anilia is gone... We used to play together in the forests all the time. I almost feel... sad.

I know something that might make me feel better. Please, slay the satyrs that took Anilia from me! Bring me their horns as proof of your actions and you will forever have my gratitude.
Bring 16 Satyr Horns to Illiyana in the Shrine of Aessina.
Please, help me avenge Anilia's death.
Thank you, kind <race>. My sister's spirit is gladdened by your efforts.
Slowing the Orc Advance

Orcs have taken over the eastern forest, and their scouts and grunts now lurk throughout the woods! It's not safe for our kind to move about Ashenvale any more.

We need to push back the orcs and secure the forest. We've been able to pick off some of the grunts and scouts by carefully sneaking around the edges of their camp.

Fight the orcs and bring me the jagged swords and curved knives that they use. I'll make sure their weapons are salvaged and repurposed, so nothing goes to waste.
Bring 6 Jagged Orc Swords and 4 Curved Orc Daggers to Shandrina.
I fear for what will become of our homes if the orcs continue to push their way deeper into the forests.

Excellent work, <name>.

I deplore the situation that requires us to resort to this kind of violence, but if the orcs aren't stopped, they'll invade Astranaar and cut down the whole wood. At least we can reuse the metal of their crude weapons to make defenses of our own.
Stolen Freewind Supplies

Those wretched harpies! They attacked the last caravan I had scheduled to deliver supplies to Freewind Post. We have enough supplies for the moment, but without more supplies, we'll run short soon.

I'm not sure what the harpies plan to do with the extra supplies, but I would be grateful if you would recover them for me. They make their lair west of here. They can be found both at the base of the cliffside and inside a cave at the top.
Bring 8 Stolen Freewind Supplies to Jandia in Freewind Post.
Have you been able to recover the supplies the harpies stole?
Thank you, <name>. These supplies will help get us through until the next shipment arrives.
Stop the Screeching

The Screeching Canyon is home to a local band of harpies known for their ferocious nature and raiding tactics. They have ambushed the last few supply caravans that have been brave enough to traverse this place.

I fear if something isn't done soon, there will be no caravans that will dare make the trek to Freewind Post.

Go, slay as many of these harpies as you are able. Return to me once the deed has been done, and I will reward you well for your efforts.
Slay 5 Screeching Harpies, 5 Screeching Roguefeather Harpies and 5 Screeching Windcaller Harpies.
Have you dealt with those awful harpies? I can't wait for the roads to be safe for the caravans again.
This is wonderful news! I will send word to our suppliers that the harpies have been dealt with. At least that is one less threat the future caravans will need to worry about.
Highperch Venom
